Q1.answer: All 57 enum modes tabulated, including all 51 special paths. Detailed page gaps named; some fine rules inferred.

Q2.answer: Stable identity and typed modifier grammar plus explicit custom consumers; no proof of unchanged schema for every year or commercial causality.

Q3.answer: All 15 prior findings confirmed, corrected, narrowed or left open in REPORT; numerical audit repeated at both commits.
